newsitem.title: USA: Stride Rite says "on track" for fiscal 1997.
newsitem.headline: Stride Rite says "on track" for fiscal 1997.

text.p: Stride Rite Corp said Thursday it is looking to the second half of the year with confidence for each of its business units, and it remains on track to achieve its goals for the rest of fiscal 1997.
The company said, however, it would prefer to be "further along" in the turnaround at Keds, its largest business. The Keds division is introducing new products for fall.
Stride Rite on Thursday reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.14 per share compared to $0.06 for the same period a year earlier.

The company also said its Tommy Hilfiger footwear business will include a launch of a boys' line for back-to-school in about 700 stores, and the delivery of twho new men's product categories -- sport outdoor and dress.
